verdict.rationale: GitLab's own technology-partner directory lists a Zulip integration that delivers notifications about GitLab projects into Zulip chat, and a Slack integration for interacting with GitLab from a Slack workspace. Both are thin directory blurbs, and neither clearly documents repo or merge-request notifications to the named tools. missing for 10: documented first-party Slack notifications for repository and merge-request events, any Discord integration, any Microsoft Teams integration, configuration/event-selection docs, hands-on corroboration.
